answer: Work waits on the marble until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vine of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
